ageingProof.integrationScenario: A 70-day INR 100 debt and a 20-day INR 50 debt receive an INR 120 FIFO payment. The report retains only INR 30 in 8-30 days; reversing that payment restores INR 100 to 60+ days and INR 50 to 8-30 days.
ageingProof.implementation: Ageing is allocated from append-only ledger rows in paise. Payments settle the oldest open debt first, and a linked payment/reversal pair is removed before allocation so the original debt age is restored.

collectionProof.amountPolicy: Collection totals include only live customer payments through cash, UPI or bank. Reversed payments, reversal entries, adjustments, returns and bill tender rows are excluded.
collectionProof.progressPolicy: Collection progress handles zero targets and clamps the displayed result to 0-100 percent.
collectionProof.datePolicy: Daily grouping uses local calendar fields and does not shift the business day through UTC conversion.

reminderSafety.featureGate: The Starter QA shop returned FEATURE_NOT_AVAILABLE before any reminder log was created.
reminderSafety.temporaryEntitlement: The synthetic shop was locally activated on Business with the explicit development-only manual override, without a purchase, and restored to Starter immediately after verification.

liveRequest.messagePreview: Namaste Meera CUST-002 QA, aapka INR 1,200 udhar pending hai. Kripya payment kar dein. - BILL-004 Mobile QA

reminderSafety.concurrency: Two simultaneous reservation attempts produce exactly one queued decision and one REMINDER_COOLDOWN_ACTIVE refusal with matching requested/cooldown audits. PostgreSQL also locks the customer row before the balance/cooldown decision.
reminderSafety.authority: Business-plan access, customer mobile, positive ledger-derived balance and owner/admin-only cooldown override are enforced by the server. Zero balance is recorded as an audited skip.

mobileUx.ageing: The customer insight surface renders substantiated 0-7, 8-30 and 30+ amounts instead of fabricating sub-buckets from one due date.
mobileUx.reminder: The primary action calls the audited reminders API, exposes queued/skipped/error truthfully, disables invalid or in-flight actions and no longer opens an unaudited wa.me link.
mobileUx.touchTargets: Collection, reminder and insight actions use a minimum 44px target contract.
mobileUx.freshAuthenticatedScreenCapture: not claimed; browser credential/PIN entry was avoided and correctness was proved through the local API and automated UI contracts

scope: Local correctness and production-readiness evidence. It does not claim a real external reminder delivery, fresh authenticated mobile screenshots, exact-candidate CI, external deployment or human release approval.
